name: Epistemic Futures Corpus
description: What the Epistemic Futures Summit's attendees have written and said, in their own words: a plain-text corpus (2005 onward) of papers, books, blog posts, op-eds, interviews, talks and public social-media posts, one file per item with source URLs, plus speaker-attributed talk transcripts and a markdown copy of the summit's public website. Compiled with AI agents (Claude) working to a written spec, with help from Jason Priem.
